QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_3

question.text: Calculate Year 1 management fees (incl. GST @ 18%) for a Cat III AIF with GNAV of Rs. 58 crore, management fee rate of 1.5% (excl. GST).

explanation.text: The Logic: Fee = 1.5% × 58 crore = Rs. 87 lakh; GST @18% = Rs. 15.66 lakh; Total = Rs. 102.66 lakh. The Trap: Rs. 87 lakh excludes GST; Rs. 97.50 lakh uses GNAV of Rs. 65 crore (Year 2); Rs. 115.05 lakh is Year 2 incl GST. Cross-Exam Context: Matches Example 1 in the NISM workbook. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Always disclose GST-inclusive fees to investors to avoid surprises at TER computation.
